original_failure: TypeError: RecordPermissions.__init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'required_clearance'
root_cause: Inline canary harness helper dict_to_evidence_pkg in .github/workflows/canary.yml passed required_clearance to RecordPermissions, which is an access-control list dataclass without clearance fields. Classification is modeled separately on EvidenceItem.classification. In addition, secondary dataclass positional argument omissions in EvidenceItem and EvidencePackage were present in the initial canary harness and have now been fully aligned.
